profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Empower
profile.summary: Principal-level engineer specializing in distributed systems and event-driven architectures. Experienced in enterprise data migrations, large-scale financial platforms, and cross-team leadership in regulated environments

positions.title: Principal Application Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Anchor for Customer Conversion (Backbook) team: responsible for driving integration readiness of customer data by building and supporting LD1+ activities for the migration of 35 million customers.

• Authored low-level design (LLD) documents for critical, high-throughput services with detailed sequence diagrams and edge-case scenarios to align 15+ upstream engineering teams.
• Designed and implemented enhancements to sso-link to make migration information available for card accounts. This enables frontend login user experience changes related to account migration.
• Introduced filtering to customer preference change exports caused by account migration related alert suppression which prevents unnecessary processing of millions of accounts per migration wave.
• Designed and implemented enhancements to customer search by PII API to allow consumers to exclude customers who have been fully migrated to Capital One to support upstream bank account recovery integration workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · REST APIs · Java · Performance Testing · Cloud-Native Applications

positions.title: Principal Application Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Anchor for Enterprise Party Contact team: responsible for unifying, streamlining, and modernizing customer contact data and services for bank and card consumers.

• Created low-level design documents for Enterprise Text/Phone Data and Permission Compliance initiatives
• Designed and implemented a Kafka Connect connector standard eliminating intermediate topics/consumers, reducing message latency and simplifying event topology across enterprise services
• Defined standard for trace header propagation at the Customer Profile org level
• Optimized queries on critical, high-throughput services, reducing outlier calls from 7 minutes to 3 seconds
• Created tooling to automate manual pipeline approval steps
• Implemented test distributions for 15-minute savings per pipeline build targeting Kubernetes/AWS/OpenShift
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Apache Kafka · Spring Boot · REST APIs · Java

positions.title: Principal Member of Technical Staff (IC4)
positions.description:
Oracle Health Applications and Infrastructure: Led development teams to tackle solutions in the interoperability, public health, and outreach spaces:
• Led migration of Direct Messaging, an encrypted S/MIME + SMTP messaging platform, from AWS to OCI, ensuring zero message loss through reissued certificates and HSM migrations
• Deployed and converted microservice/feed applications to on-prem cloud on VMware TAS, built CI/CD pipelines, developed automated testing strategy, monitoring, and alerting
• Immunization Hub, which provides states with vaccination updates and clients query by parameter functionality
• Reference Lab Network, which enable clients to connect to performing labs through a single standard connectivity tunnel

positions.title: Software Engineer V
positions.description:
• Technical and managing lead for a remote team developing a suite of web applications for Cerner's Direct HISP (Health Information Service Provider), which provides secure interoperability APIs that enable communication with external systems for multiple solutions across the company.
• Serve as subject matter expert for the VA (Veterans Affairs), other Oracle Cerner teams, as well as overseas development teams in India/Ukraine.
• Participate in DirectTrust community workgroups to help influence and evolve standards and practices: Security and Trust Compliance, Certificate Policies & Practices, Direct Directory Policy; Participate in DirectTrust Standards Consensus Body
• Owner and maintainer of open source Direct Project Java reference implementation
• Collaborate with product management team to envision roadmaps, quarterly plans/goals
• Successfully onboarded the eCR Now solution onto the Direct platform, enabling electronic initial case report data to be securely delivered to the CDC via AIMS to give public health officials a more detailed and real-time view of the spread of COVID-19.
• Develop automated, proactive monitoring tasks with corresponding daily reports for edge endpoints and public DNS health, to provide actionable tasks for the operations team.

positions.title: MakerSpace Administrator
positions.description:
• Create and facilitate workshop sessions to teach interested associates a variety of Maker skills framed around challenging yet enjoyable projects: Arduino code based electronics, parametric 3D modeling, 3D printing, vector graphic designs for laser engraving/cutting.
• Create machine usage training material (videos/documentation) for user education and onboarding.
• Hold regular office hours to assist MakerSpace users with projects.

positions.title: Lead Engineering Manager
positions.description:
• Migrated on-prem applications to Pivotal Cloud Foundry/VMWare Tanzu Application Service on AWS.
• Create Direct troubleshooting dashboard to monitor inbound/outbound traffic volume by domain, message round trip duration, errors by application--providing a high-level view of the health and state of the HISP and CDWI, so that the team can respond more effectively if/when unexpected issues arise.
• Built highly scalable event-driven microservices in a distributed system
• Improved existing test processes for the ePrescribing team by 1) developing a standard approach to creating execution plan based testing to automate scenarios that previously required manual setup steps and 2) automating runs of tests against legacy environments by utilizing Spring profiles to deploy scheduled integration test apps to Tanzu.

positions.title: Knowledge Architect
positions.description:
• Implemented address trust validation API, which allows consumers to determine trust between sender and recipient(s)
• Improved virus scan workflow performance through modifications to the message workflow.
• Accountable for team's software design and code quality
• Collaborated with solution management to develop functional workflows and business rules

positions.title: Lead Architect
positions.description:
• Served as Scrum Master, technical lead, and manager for agile team comprised of associates with a variety of technical and non-technical roles.
• Designed, developed, and maintained scripts for zero downtime deployments of web applications and highly available APIs with heavy traffic.
• Created real-time map visualization of message traffic to demonstrate the growth and usage of the HISP. Iterations of this application were showcased in the CHC (Cerner Health Conference) solution gallery for 4 consecutive years.
• Designed and implemented web application for automated load testing and monitoring of message transport performance (via outbound to inbound roundtrip duration) with integrated alerting capabilities.
• Designed and implemented web application for searching HPD (Healthcare Provider Directory) data, embedded with Millennium workflows (via mPage).
• Created DigiCert Direct API client library, an integral part of the migration from self hosted certificate authority.
• Replaced disk backed mail queueing system with RabbitMQ to improve performance, reliability, and ease of deployment.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
• Architected new workflows and extended existing functionality of secure web inbox solution.
• Implemented OpenID SSO (CernerCare professional and associate IdP) for inbox, CE Tool, EA Tool, and Invitation Claim Tool to enable end user login
• Mentored technical interns and conducted technical interviews to grow a strong agile development team.
• Established pattern for automated cross-browser UI testing using Selenium to allow for targeted and full regression testing to reduce defect escape.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, implement, enhance, and test web-based software solutions for patient charts and health records.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
• Developed 2 mobile games using webOS SDK which were published to the HP App Catalog (app store for webOS devices), each receiving over 200k unique downloads/4.x rating
• Apps included online leaderboards, featured content, free lite/premium versions
• Provided support via email
positions.insights: Skills: Game Development · WebOS · User Interface Design · Mobile Applications
